name: Sister Vreni
role: Senior of the Kindly Rest — she runs the house, the terraces and the drying lofts, and has not had enough hands in two years
appearance: Sixty-odd, weathered, grey hair cut short because it is practical. Forearms marked with old burn scars from the drying lofts. Wears the house's undyed wool with the sleeves pushed up, always, and a harvesting knife on a cord at her hip.
voiceHints: Plain, unhurried, and funnier than people expect. Asks a real question and then waits through the whole silence for the answer. Says 'good' when something is good and nothing at all when it is not.
wants: Enough trained hands that the high terraces stop going unharvested, and for the house to keep being the kind of place a person can arrive at.
fears: That she will have to start asking who somebody is before she takes them in.
knowledge: Every herb that grows on the south shoulder, what it is for, and which three of them nobody has managed to cultivate
That someone in the house is living under a name that is not theirs, and that she decided not to ask
Which families down in Millbrook took sick at the First Sickness and which of them mended
That the Echo has been running clean since around world-day 26, because the house's water stopped needing to be boiled

reactsToReputation.any: she looks at your hands before your face, and decides most of it there
reactsToReputation.healer: immediate, unsentimental welcome — she will have you working within the hour and thank you afterwards
reactsToReputation.cruel: the welcome does not close, and it goes very quiet
reactsToReputation.renowned: unimpressed in a way that is not rudeness; the house has had famous people in it and they still had to wash

questSeeds: She is short-handed and asking — the high terraces have not been properly harvested in two seasons
Two separate parties have come asking politely after somebody sheltering here, and she has answered neither
physicality: Sixty-odd and weathered. Moves like someone who has carried things all her life — sits down heavily, gets up slowly. Forearms marked with old burn scars from the drying lofts, sleeves pushed up in any weather. Grey hair cut short because it is practical.
gear: a harvesting knife on a cord, honed weekly
a pruning hook on a long haft
a case of prepared remedies, labelled in her own hand
_authoredWhy: ⛑ AUTHORED 2026-09-16 for Courtney's Adelheid. Erik's brief: a monastery where she works as the healer she is, herbs, painting, spirituality, and intrigue that is 'less heavy'. ⛔ VRENI IS THE DOOR — CCODE-357 built `invitationPressures` so a quest bound to a character sends its giver to find them once, and Vreni is who walks through it. ⚠️ SHE IS NOT A QUEST-GIVER WHO HAPPENS TO BE KIND: she is short-handed, she has read Adelheid's work, and she is asking for help because she needs it. An invitation that is really a favour being asked is the one a healer would accept.
